# ghost/maps

Google Maps without an account: look up a place, list search results, identify what is at coordinates, get a route summary for any travel mode.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/maps
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/maps search_place --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/maps list_places --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/maps show_location --device <serial> --param lat=<lat> --param lng=<lng>
ghost skill run ghost/maps get_directions --device <serial> --param origin=<origin> --param destination=<destination>
```

## Actions

- `search_place`: Find the Brandenburg Gate on Google Maps
- `list_places`: Find cafes near Alexanderplatz Berlin
- `show_location`: What is at 52.5163, 13.3777?
- `get_directions`: How long does it take to walk from Alexanderplatz to the Brandenburg Gate?
